instructions_coverage.notes: scenario-01 covers the read-first, no-duplicate, schema-validated append workflow; scenario-02 covers rejecting a vague directive and reformatting it correctly; scenario-03 covers refusing an ephemeral-note rule and redirecting it; scenario-04 covers detecting near-duplicate/overlapping rules and suggesting amendment over duplication. The 'only invoke when explicitly requested' scoping instruction is exercised implicitly by every scenario's framing rather than as a standalone check.
